conv.AscensionStone.confirming-ends-this: Confirming ends this character. Its name goes on the memorial.
conv.AscensionStone.pick-one-reward-it-u: Pick one reward. It unlocks permanently for this character slot.
conv.AscensionStone.spending-one-here-un: Spending one here unlocks a permanent reward for its character slot.
conv.AscensionStone.you-are-max-level-so: You are max level, so you can spend this character here.
conv.AscensionStone.you-pick-one-reward-: You pick one reward. It stays unlocked for every future character in this slot.
conv.Baabara.ill-take-that-as: I'll take that as a yes.
conv.Benjamin.ah-good-im-glad-she: Ah good, I'm glad she sent some help.
conv.Benjamin.can-i-just-pull-them: Can I just pull them out of the ground?
conv.Benjamin.flora-sends-me-to-harvest: Flora sends me to harvest the beets.
conv.Benjamin.harvesting-is-done-standin: Harvesting is done standing, close to the plant.
conv.Benjamin.hello-stranger-what-can-i: Hello, stranger. What can I do for you?
conv.Benjamin.i-can-teach-you: I can teach you the Harvest aura.
conv.Benjamin.ill-teach-you-harvest-make: I'll teach you Harvest. Make it your active aura and stand close to the beets.
conv.Benjamin.that-wont-work-you-need: That won't work. You need to have the Harvest aura active.
conv.Benjamin.you-can-only-have-one: You can only have one active aura at a time. The new auras you learn, you'll find in your spellbook.
conv.CaveExit.a-narrow-shaft-and-dayligh: A narrow shaft, and daylight at the top of it.
conv.CaveExit.you-climb-back-into: You climb back into the light.
conv.CaveMouth.a-dark-opening: A dark opening in the rock.
conv.CaveMouth.cold-air-rises-out: Cold air rises out of it.
conv.CaveMouth.you-climb-down-into: You climb down into the dark.
conv.CityGuard.kill-5-bears-near: Kill 5 bears near the city walls, then come back to me.
conv.CityGuard.kill-5-bears-near-2: Kill 5 bears near the city walls, then come back to me.
conv.CityGuard.the-8-wolves: The 8 wolves on the west road are dead.
conv.CityGuard.the-front-is: The front is in the south. They need fighters.
conv.CityGuard.the-gate-is-closed: The gate is closed. The orcs are too close.
conv.CityGuard.where-can-i-make-myself: Where can I make myself useful?
conv.DeadCarter.a-dead-carter-lies-face: A dead carter lies face down beside his burnt cart.
conv.DeadCarter.his-purse-is-gone: His purse is gone and his crates are smashed. There are arrows in the wood of the cart.
conv.Dog.are-you-the-shepherds-lost: Are you the shepherd's lost dog?
conv.Dog.maybe-its-time: Maybe it's time for a new profession ...
conv.Emberkeeper.bandits-hide-in-the-dar: Bandits hide in the dark forest.
conv.Emberkeeper.campfires-are-scattered: Campfires are scattered around. Sit at one and you respawn there.
conv.Emberkeeper.kill-6-bandits: Kill 6 bandits from the camp east of here, then come back to me.
conv.Emberkeeper.kill-6-bandits-2: Kill 6 bandits from the camp east of here, then come back to me.
conv.Emberkeeper.north-where-the-hills-c: North, where the hills close in. Take a light.
conv.Emberkeeper.the-camp-is-east: The camp is east of here.
conv.Emberkeeper.you-can-rest-at-my: You can rest at my fire.
conv.FallenTraveller.a-dead-traveller: A dead traveller in a grey cloak, deep in the kobold den.
conv.FallenTraveller.his-pack-has-been-e: His pack has been emptied. A broken walking staff lies beside him.
conv.Farmhand.sometimes-i-feel-like-thes: Sometimes I feel like these turnips are hiding even deeper in the ground once I'm around to pull them out ...
conv.Farmhand.these-rats-they-were-bigge: These rats ... They were bigger than my forearm. I'm not going back in there!
conv.Flora.5-of-them-would-replenish: 5 of them would replenish our meat supplies and give some substance to our stews.
conv.Flora.ahh-what-a-sight: Ahh ... what a sight for sore eyes. I'll prepare them right away.
conv.Flora.be-quick-stags-tend: Be quick. Stags tend to run faster than beets.
conv.Flora.but-you-should-talk: But you should talk to miller Reinhard, who lives further east.
conv.Flora.come-back-here-when-youre: Come back here when you're done.
conv.Flora.do-you-have-anything-else: Do you have anything else to do?
conv.Flora.do-you-have-anything-else-2: Do you have anything else to do?
conv.Flora.here-you-go-the-meat: Here you go! The meat of 5 deer.
conv.Flora.ive-got-a-beet-field: I've got a beet field in the east that's ready for harvesting. Make yourself useful and harvest 10 beets.
conv.Flora.since-you-are-young: Since you are young and strong, would you mind hunting some deer for me?
conv.Flora.so-you-came-here-looking: So ... you came here looking for work?
conv.Flora.sure-ill-talk: Sure, I'll talk to the miller.
conv.Flora.talk-to-benjamin-first-hes: Talk to Benjamin first. He's right in front of the field.
conv.Flora.talk-to-benjamin-he-can: Talk to Benjamin, he can teach you how to harvest.
conv.Flora.thanks-stranger-thats-all: Thanks, stranger. That's all the work I have for now.
conv.Flora.thanks-the-old-bones-wont: Thanks ... the old bones won't bend like they used to, so I appreciate the help.
conv.Flora.youll-find-them: You'll find them in the south. My husband Henrik should be able to teach you how to hunt properly.
conv.Flora.youll-find-them-further-south: You'll find them further south, right after the fenced field.
conv.FrontAscensionStone.confirming-ends: Confirming ends this character. Its name goes on the memorial.
conv.FrontAscensionStone.front-stone-a-l: Front stone. A life can be laid down here.
conv.FrontAscensionStone.pick-one-reward: Pick one reward. It unlocks permanently for this character slot.
conv.FrontAscensionStone.spending-a-char: Spending a character here unlocks a permanent reward for its character slot.
conv.FrontAscensionStone.you-held-the-li: You held the line, and you are far enough along the road. You can spend this character here.
conv.FrontAscensionStone.you-pick-one-re: You pick one reward. It stays unlocked for every future character in this slot.
conv.FrontCaptain.break-the-banners-in-h: Break the banners in his camp west of here, then kill him.
conv.FrontCaptain.he-cannot-be-hurt-whil: He cannot be hurt while his war banners stand.
conv.FrontCaptain.how-do-i-bring-down: How do I bring down the Orc Commander?
conv.FrontCaptain.kill-5-orcs: Kill 5 orcs on the front line south of here, then come back to me.
conv.FrontCaptain.kill-5-orcs-2: Kill 5 orcs on the front line south of here, then come back to me.
conv.GladeRoot.the-wisps-drift-around: The wisps drift around a root that hums. Somewhere, an old tree smiles.
conv.Governor.about-the-wolves: About the wolves in the farmlands...
conv.Governor.then-the-crier-was-right: Then the Crier was right to send you. I will ask the Order to look into it.
conv.Governor.there-are-more-wolves: There are more wolves on the farms than anyone can remember.
conv.GrandfatherKnot.ah-a-little-walker-: Ah. A little walker. You move so... quickly.
conv.GrandfatherKnot.come-back-in-about: Come back in about a century, little walker. Tell me how your journey went.
conv.GrandfatherKnot.east-where-the-wisp: East, where the wisps gather. The last one. Probably.
conv.GrandfatherKnot.good-i-will-wait-i: Good. I will wait. I am good at waiting.
conv.GrandfatherKnot.good-west-to-the-st: Good. West, to the stream. I will be here.
conv.GrandfatherKnot.hm-that-one-was-awa: Hm. That one was awake already. Or it is now. Try the one by the stones, to the south.
conv.GrandfatherKnot.my-grove-is-choked: My grove is choked with deadwood, little walker. Clear it for an old tree?
conv.GrandfatherKnot.my-roots-run-beneat: My roots run beneath all of it. Through them I hum the wood to rest. But three of my roots have fallen asleep.
conv.GrandfatherKnot.six-heaps-will-do: Six heaps will do. The rest can wait a winter.
conv.GrandfatherKnot.south-the-root: South. The root by the stones. Take your time. I do.
conv.GrandfatherKnot.the-root-by-the-sto: The root by the stones is awake.
conv.GrandfatherKnot.the-root-by-the-str: The root by the stream is awake.
conv.GrandfatherKnot.the-young-trees-of-: The young trees of this wood have grown angry, little walker. Have you met them?
conv.GrandfatherKnot.there-do-you-feel-i: There. Do you feel it? You have walked my roots end to end.
conv.GrandfatherKnot.wake-them-for-me-on: Wake them for me. One sleeps by the stream, to the west. Lay a hand on it.
conv.GrandfatherKnot.was-it-warm-no-then: Was it warm? No? Then it was asleep. Good. The last one lies east, where the wisps gather.
conv.GrandfatherKnot.west-little-walker-: West, little walker. The root by the stream.
conv.Hans.can-you-help-me-i: Can you help me? I reckon you can ...
conv.Hans.find-them-out: Find them out in the pasture and kill 6 of them.
conv.Hans.find-them-out-2: Find them out in the pasture and kill 6 of them.
conv.Hans.its-very-unsettling-that-were: It's very unsettling that we're plagued by so many wolves. Tell the Town Crier, close to Reinhard's farm.
conv.Hans.maybe-he-knows-why-so: Maybe he knows why so many are on our farms recently.
conv.Hans.please-help-me-find-them: Please help me find them before the wolves do. They are probably around the pasture somewhere.
conv.Hans.the-governor-of-dionsburg-then: The Governor of Dionsburg? Then follow the road east through the forest.
conv.Hans.these-dangerous-wolves-are: These dangerous wolves are a threat to all of us, especially to my sheep!
conv.Hans.they-are-a-featherbrained-lot: They are a featherbrained lot. I'm sure they're grazing peacefully somewhere in the farmlands.
conv.Hans.wolves-scared-away-my-sheep: Wolves scared away my sheep! And my darn dog ran right after them.
conv.Hans.you-dont-carry-that-weapon: You don't carry that weapon for vanity, huh? Still, so many wolves ... You should tell the Town Crier, close to Reinhard's farm. Maybe he knows why.
conv.Henrik.a-stag-will-start: A stag will start to run the moment you hurt it.
conv.Henrik.flora-sends-me-to-hunt: Flora sends me to hunt some deer.
conv.Henrik.how-do-i-hunt: How do I hunt a stag?
conv.Henrik.ill-teach-you-one-thing: I'll teach you one thing. Learn it properly.
conv.Henrik.no-problem-ill-kill: No problem, I'll kill the deer in no time.
conv.Henrik.with-that-tiny-knife-you: With that tiny knife you carry? Hahaha! Come here, I'll teach you how to hunt.
conv.Henrik.with-the-wild-aura-youll: With the Wild aura you'll have a larger reach. Choose Wild as your active aura and give it your best shot!
conv.Henrik.you-wont-win-by-hitting: You won't win by hitting harder. You win by staying close.
conv.Hermit.i-talked-to-reinhard: I talked to Reinhard and the Town Crier.
conv.Hermit.talk-to-reinhard: Talk to Reinhard and the Town Crier, then come back to me.
conv.Hermit.talk-to-reinhard-2: Talk to Reinhard and the Town Crier, then come back to me.
conv.Lambert.why-am-i-even-talking: Why am I even talking to a sheep?
conv.LamplessTraveller.kill-6-kobolds-no: Kill 6 kobolds north of the tunnel, then come back to me.
Kill 6 kobolds north of the tunnel, then come back to me.
conv.LamplessTraveller.what-are-you-doin: What are you doing out here?
conv.LamplessTraveller.you-get-my-lamp-w: You get my lamp when it is done.
conv.Lamplighter.i-can-teach-you: I can teach you to make light.
conv.Lamplighter.kill-4-dire-wolves: Kill 4 dire wolves in the dark forest, then come back to me.
conv.Lamplighter.kill-4-dire-wolves-2: Kill 4 dire wolves in the dark forest, then come back to me.
conv.Lionett.do-you-have-work: Do you have work for me?
conv.Lionett.id-hoped-youd-say-that: I'd hoped you'd say that. You need to harvest seaweed from the shore up north. 8 strands should suffice.
conv.Lionett.if-you-help-me-gather: If you help me gather the ingredients, I'll let you in on the recipe.
conv.Lionett.indeed-i-do-im-about: Indeed I do! I'm about to brew a special tea that helps you regain focus.
conv.Lionett.ohh-a-new-face-around: Ohh ... a new face around here.
conv.Lionett.youll-find-seaweed: You'll find seaweed to the north, close to the shore. Once you're there, use your Harvest aura to gather it.
conv.MemorialStone.every-character-spent: Every character spent at the ascension stone, newest first.
conv.Miner.first-the-kobolds-now: First the Kobolds, now the Spiders. Things are getting worse every day.
conv.Miner.kill-6-spiders: Kill 6 spiders in the tunnel diggings, then come back to me.
conv.Miner.kill-6-spiders-2: Kill 6 spiders in the tunnel diggings, then come back to me.
conv.PortalHome.it-leads-to-the-campfire: It leads to the campfire the caster is bound to.
conv.PortalSummon.it-leads-to-whoever-op: It leads to whoever opened it.
conv.Reinhard.about-the-rats: About the rats in the granary...
conv.Reinhard.already-very-good-this-wil: Already? Very good, this will teach them to come after my grain!
conv.Reinhard.and-not-a-scratch: And not a scratch on it. You're an honest one, aren't you?
conv.Reinhard.and-youre-still-in-one: And you're still in one piece? You're sturdier than you look. Good job.
conv.Reinhard.be-careful-its-dark: Be careful! It's dark in there and the rats are nasty beasts. Don't attract too many at once.
conv.Reinhard.be-careful-once-you-get: Be careful once you get close to their den. The beast will not be the only boar you'll encounter there.
conv.Reinhard.flora-sends-me-im-looking: Flora sends me. I'm looking for work.
conv.Reinhard.floras-a-good-judge: Flora's a good judge of people. Plenty of work around here, stranger.
conv.Reinhard.go-inside-the-granary-kill: Go inside the granary, kill 8 of the beasts and come back to me.
conv.Reinhard.go-to-the-granary: Go to the granary and climb down the ladder.
conv.Reinhard.great-it-must-be-tangled: Great! It must be tangled in the seaweed somewhere on the shore.
conv.Reinhard.harvest-5-turnips: Harvest 5 turnips from the row north of here, then come back to me.
conv.Reinhard.harvest-5-turnips-2: Harvest 5 turnips from the row north of here, then come back to me.
conv.Reinhard.he-hasnt-returned-yet: He hasn't returned yet and I fear for him. Could you travel east and look for him? I'm afraid some harm has come to him.
conv.Reinhard.i-have-a-delicate-task: I have a ... delicate task for you.
conv.Reinhard.it-should-be-somewhere: It should be somewhere in the seaweed on the beach, north from here.
conv.Reinhard.just-follow-the-road: Just follow the road and cross the bridge that leads to the forest. That's the road Tobias has taken.
conv.Reinhard.kill-6-of-them-then: Kill 6 of them, then report back to me. You'll find my fields north and south of the farm.
conv.Reinhard.mind-the-boars-though-they: Mind the boars, though. They usually don't attack unless provoked.
conv.Reinhard.my-wife-hasnt-noticed-yet: My wife hasn't noticed yet and I'd prefer it stays this way. So please ... would you mind looking for it at the beach?
conv.Reinhard.plenty-of-work-around-here: Plenty of work around here, stranger.
conv.Reinhard.since-i-know-now-that: Since I know now that you have a fierce heart and know how to fight, I have another task for you.
conv.Reinhard.thank-you-i-knew-i: Thank you! I knew I could count on you.
conv.Reinhard.the-boars-can-put-up: The boars can put up quite a fight. Be careful not to attract too many at a time.
conv.Reinhard.the-fields-are-safe: The fields are safe for now, but the darn boars will return.
conv.Reinhard.the-fields-where-i-plant: The fields where I plant the grain for the mill are overrun with boars. They destroy the harvest!
conv.Reinhard.the-granarys-right-behind-: The granary's right behind you. Good luck!
conv.Reinhard.these-darn-rats-have-taken: These darn rats have taken over the granary. Large as my forearm they are.
conv.Reinhard.they-came: They came in with the grain sacks. Big as a cat, and they bite.
conv.Reinhard.they-have-a-den-south: They have a den south of this farm. It's protected by a real beast! Kill it, and our crops will finally be safe!
conv.Reinhard.they-usually-dont-attack-u: They usually don't attack unless provoked.
conv.Reinhard.two-days-ago-i-sent: Two days ago, I sent my farmhand Tobias east to the city of Dionsburg with a shipment ... and a special letter for someone in the city.
conv.Reinhard.whilst-fishing-on-the-beac: Whilst fishing on the beach, I seem to have lost my wedding ring.
conv.Reinhard.you-need-the-harvest-skill: You need the Harvest skill for that. Ask me to teach you first.
conv.Reinhard.you-rid-these-lands: You rid these lands of a nasty beast. Maybe you're not a farmer after all ... maybe you're a warrior!
conv.ReinhardsWife.he-thinks-i-havent-no: He thinks I haven't noticed that his wedding band's missing ...
conv.Shaman.kill-6-dire-wolves-around: Kill 6 dire wolves around my camp, then come back to me.
conv.Shaman.kill-6-dire-wolves-around-2: Kill 6 dire wolves around my camp, then come back to me.
conv.Shaman.let-nature-guide-you: Let nature guide you. But also be aware of nature. It's complicated.
conv.Shaman.the-8-wolves: The 8 wolves on the west road are dead.
conv.StoneRoot.a-root-clenched-around: A root clenched around the stones like a fist. It loosens under your hand.
conv.StreamRoot.a-cold-root-damp: A cold root, damp from the stream. It stirs under your hand.
conv.Tobias.are-you-all-right-what: Are you all right? What happened?
conv.Tobias.bandits-they-took-the-cart: Bandits. They took the cart and burned it up the road. I barely got away, but I still have the letter.
conv.Tobias.reinhard-sent-me-to-look: Reinhard sent me to look for you.
conv.Tobias.stay-back-oh-youre-not: Stay back! ... Oh. You're not one of them.
conv.TownCrier.alas-i-know-neither: Alas, I know neither the cause nor the cure.
conv.TownCrier.but-maybe-someone-in-dion: But maybe someone in Dionsburg knows what to do ... You should talk to its Governor about our problem.
conv.TownCrier.hans-sends-me-there-are: Hans sends me. There are a lot of wolves recently.
conv.TownCrier.he-resides-in-the-cathedr: He resides in the Cathedral, in the centre of Dionsburg.
conv.TownCrier.hes-a-champion-of-humanit: He's a champion of humanity and all of its allies against the forces of evil.
conv.TownCrier.indeed-its-very-unusual-t: Indeed ... it's very unusual that they appear in such great numbers.
conv.TownCrier.its-a-large-city: It's a large city to the east. It's the dwelling place of the Order of Divine Light.
conv.TownCrier.its-a-mighty-guild: It's a mighty guild of paladins, champions of the righteous cause.
conv.TownCrier.kill-8-wolves: Kill 8 wolves on the west road.
conv.TownCrier.kill-8-wolves-2: Kill 8 wolves on the west road. Then report to the City Guard or the Shaman.
conv.TownCrier.oh-i-just-know-what: Oh, I just know what everyone knows about him.
conv.TownCrier.splendid-just-follow-the-: Splendid! Just follow the road east through the forest. It'll lead you right to the city gates.
Splendid! Just follow the road east through the forest. It'll lead you right to the city gates.
Splendid! Just follow the road east through the forest. It'll lead you right to the city gates.
Splendid! Just follow the road east through the forest. It'll lead you right to the city gates.
conv.TownCrier.talk-to-farmer-flora-mill: Talk to Farmer Flora, Miller Reinhard, Herbalist Lionett and Shepherd Hans.
conv.TownCrier.tell-me-more-about: Tell me more about the Order of Divine Light.
conv.TownCrier.then-report-to-the-city: Then report to the City Guard at the city gate far to the east, or to the Shaman at his fire east along the road.
conv.TownCrier.they-defend-the-city: They defend the city and uphold the laws in Dionsburg. They are led by a powerful paladin called Papath.
conv.TownCrier.who-here-has-work: Who here has work for me?
conv.TownCrier.youll-find-flora-and-hans: You'll find Flora and Hans to the west, Lionett to the north and Reinhard just south of here. There's always something to do.
conv.VillageHealer.kill-5-alpha-wolves-a: Kill 5 alpha wolves around the village, then come back to me.
Kill 5 alpha wolves around the village, then come back to me.
conv.VillageHealer.rest-by-the-fire: Rest by the fire and regain your strength.
conv.Wanderer.east-is-dangerous-bandits-: East is dangerous. Bandits watch that road.
conv.Wanderer.he-wears-a-grey-cloak: He wears a grey cloak and carries a walking staff. Please find him.
conv.Wanderer.he-went-into-the-forest: He went into the forest for berries. A grey cloak and a walking staff.
conv.Wanderer.i-feared-as-much-thank: I feared as much. Thank you for telling me.
conv.Wanderer.i-found-him-he-is: I found him. He is dead.
conv.Wanderer.kill-8-kobolds-near: Kill 8 kobolds near the road, then come back to me.
conv.Wanderer.kill-8-kobolds-near-2: Kill 8 kobolds near the road, then come back to me.
conv.Wanderer.north-through-the-tunnel-b: North, through the tunnel. Bring a light.
conv.Wanderer.not-by-choice-my-friend: Not by choice. My friend went into the forest to collect berries and did not come back.
